tiers.name: Single-Thread Regex Pre-Tokenization + O(N^2) Full-History decode(all_ids) Per Step
tiers.note: 512KB unspaced JSON triggers regex backtracking (640ms TTFT penalty), and re-decoding all 4,096 tokens every step at BS=256 stalls CPU 4.80ms/step!

tiers.name: Naive Single-Token decode([token_id]) Without UTF-8 Byte-Fallback Buffer
tiers.note: Fast O(1) per step (0.12ms), but multi-byte UTF-8 CJK/Emoji split across 2 byte-level BPE tokens emit replacement chars (81.5% fidelity)!

tiers.name: HF Rust Fast Tokenizer in Main Engine Process + Sliding-Window Detokenizer
tiers.note: Preserves 100% UTF-8 fidelity and O(1) detokenization, but running 42ms Rust BPE inside the main engine process still blocks GPU scheduling.

tiers.name: Disaggregated ZMQ Rust Chunked Tokenizer Pool + O(1) 6-Token UTF-8 Window Detokenizer
tiers.note: Splits 512KB prompts into 32KB newline/punctuation chunks across Rust worker pool (11.5ms, 55.7x faster) + O(1) 6-token UTF-8 state machine (0.08ms/step)!
